data.long_meaning: Bahiah is an Arabic name for girls that means 'beautiful', 'radiant', 'shining'. It is derived from the word bahiyy which means 'bright', 'shining'. The name Bahiah carries the meaning “Beautiful, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Bahiah usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
